annotation.title_clean: La Commissione pubblica orientamenti sulla definizione di sistema di IA per facilitare l'applicazione delle norme della prima legge sull'IA
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on AI system definition to facilitate application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing non-binding guidelines on the AI system definition under the EU AI Act, published February 2025 alongside guidelines on prohibited practices. It links to download the guidelines in all EU languages and notes the first AI Act rules applied from 2 February 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines help providers determine whether a software system is an AI system under the AI Act
Guidelines are non-binding and will be updated based on practical experience
Published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices
First AI Act rules apply from 2 February 2025: AI system definition, AI literacy, prohibited practices
AI Act classifies systems into risk categories: prohibited, high-risk, transparency obligations
